scenes.text: You’re walking through a peaceful English forest, and you spot a tiny, beautiful stream that you could easily jump across.
But if you slip and fall into the Bolton Abbey Strid, your chances of survival are literally zero.
The water has carved out massive, hidden underwater caves and powerful currents that will trap you instantly beneath the rocks.
Would you dare to even stand near the edge of this water? Tell me in the comments, and hit follow for more mind-blowing nature secrets.
